parole.significato: kermes insect (Kermes ilicis, an insect found on the kermes oak that is used to make crimson dyes)
parole.testo: PIE word  *kʷŕ̥mis From Persian *کرمست (*kermest), ultimately from Proto-Indo-Iranian *kŕ̥miš (“worm”). Compare Old Armenian կարմիր (karmir), Hebrew כַּרְמִיל (karmīl), Iranian borrowings.
